title: Halo Dental footer
description: A black footer panel inset by a thin margin with 8px corners: three link columns with 28px headings, a white outline button and an orange button top right, a wide illustration slot across the middle and a small grey legal row at the bottom.
notes: always uses the theme's dark palette; the thin margin shows what's behind it (pass a background through className)
pass the line illustration through media; the default is a faint pool of light
